geometryAndOverflow.derivation: Raw line-bound drift was 0pt in 33 paired shape observations. The rounding quantum is 0.01pt and the release delta is two quanta. A requested 0.25pt deficit reopened as 0.200001pt, so 0.25pt is the hard residual ceiling; values above it rasterize before admission. Five and ten point counters remain diagnostics and never relax the 0.25pt release ceiling.

visualMetrics.derivation: Fresh Gate 1 actual-product visual metrics from product attempt 09 contained 64 comparisons. The 32 threshold failures were exclusively source-vs-first-open or source-vs-reopen comparisons; all cross-mode and first-open-vs-reopen comparisons passed. The observed maxima were 15055 ppm changed pixels, minimum SSIM 999965 millionths, maximum mean absolute channel delta 24 milli, and maximum RMSE 302 milli. The changed-pixel ceiling is raised to 16000 ppm, a bounded 945 ppm margin over the observed maximum; SSIM, mean-delta, and RMSE ceilings remain 998500 millionths, 100 milli, and 3200 milli. Structural zero-defect requirements remain unchanged.

chart.derivation: Three corrected sealed Gate -1 trials observed exact first/reopen category, value, cache-literal and explicit sRGB style carriers for the bounded line and single-series pie fixtures. Only those two families are admitted; every other chart family and any automatic/theme color, marker, custom typography or multi-series pie remains raster.

paintGraph.derivation: The bounded profile caps 256 logical owners and four physical nodes per owner. The edge cap is the undirected 32-neighbor bound 1024*32/2. Any interleaving above the single raster-underlay cut, atomic opacity/filter/mask/transform group, or budget overflow demotes the promotion unit or the slide.

workerTiming.derivation: Observed open/reopen maxima were 125ms and save-copy maximum was 4893ms. Stage limits are at least 12x the observed maxima and the 600s attempt wall covers sixteen 30s slide renders plus open/save/reopen allowance. One retry is allowed only for transient infrastructure failure before assembly; evidence failures quarantine immediately.

freshness.derivation: A worker must first attest measured clock skew no greater than 10s; the validator permits three times that value. Worker/environment evidence covers one 600s attempt plus 300s margin. CI and completion cover two bounded attempts. Projection and deployment receipts are shorter use-time decisions.

retention.derivation: The 180-day metadata and 30-day evidence values retain the existing reviewed v1 policy. Evidence v2 adds a 24-hour digest-verified unbound grace, active-receipt pins, legal-hold precedence, and a separately authorized erasure controller; this design performs no deletion.
